acceptance.resource_rule: Any increase above 10% requires an explicit cause and independent review; no automatic override.

interpretation.mcp: Actual unchanged SDK stdio call/envelope with empty query-result cache and normal cache-write cost. Each configuration starts a fresh server process; private memo counters are not exposed. Actual process RSS remains measured.
interpretation.native: Complete API call with query-result cache disabled and a bounded exact-token-count memo naturally retained on each candidate book. Only latency_ms is excluded from equality; native memo observations are outside timing.
interpretation.quality: Old-data regression, complete output equality; no new-domain or generated-answer claim.
interpretation.resources: Startup, ingest/replay, native and actual MCP process memory measured separately.
interpretation.timing: Four ABBA rounds on one machine; all samples retained, no cold-OS or significance claim.

plan.correctness: Complete stable output must match for every query, config, engine and round. Exclude only native latency_ms. Verify source spans, exact tokenizer counts, scope, result limits, indexed content, MCP envelope and cache policy.
plan.durability: Commit plan/evaluator, then exact baseline/candidate binding before formal timing. Exclusive binding execution claim and per-worker start marker prevent duplicate runs; fsync each per-query start/finish and checkpoint every completed worker. Commit raw state and results in small checkpoints. Keep interrupted attempts and adverse metrics.
plan.failure_rule: Do not rerun completed formal measurements to select better samples, relax gates after outcomes, hide failed attempts, or claim speedup on a failed gate. A demonstrated correctness bug requires preserved failure evidence and a new explicitly documented candidate.

formal.execution: Sequential isolated workers, one host, fixed shuffled query order per round/config; no concurrent benchmark. Native cache_size=0/use_cache=False; actual MCP result cache cleared before call outside timing, cache-write cost included.

plan.resource_review: All recorded startup, ingest/replay and RSS means retained. Increase over 10% requires explicit cause assessment and independent review; no automatic waiver.
plan.scope: Exact-output efficiency versus v0.3.2 on old regression data. Existing third-party component results remain historical and do not establish a new whole-product or all-dimensions win. No generated answer or new-domain transfer claim.

cache_policy.cold_warm_boundary: Preserve original connection lifecycles, configuration order and shuffled query orders. Each fresh connection starts empty; native later token configurations can reuse prior counts on that connection. Each actual MCP configuration starts a fresh official server process. No extra prewarming, no discarded first queries, and no selective cache clearing.
cache_policy.continuation: C6 retains the exact C5 token memo. No additional persistent feature or statement cache is introduced.
cache_policy.diagnostics: Save native memo state before/after every configuration outside timing, including start/hits/misses/evictions/entries/text bytes and cold-prefix observations where available. Preserve original actual SDK MCP command, protocol and measured envelope; private memo counters are not exposed over MCP. Its cold process boundary and actual process RSS are recorded. Do not describe this experiment as disabling every cache.
cache_policy.ownership: one MemoryBook connection; both encoders share limits

requirements: Before timing, verify the complete official-SDK output transcript and normal result-cache behavior, transport operation counts, source/runtime identities, error/flush/cancellation/EOF behavior and all supported/custom fallbacks.

Commit the materially changed C7 source and tests before its sole complete native AB/BA development comparison. Preserve all 18928 calls, 9464 full-output pairs and adverse observations even though the selected change targets MCP only.
Perform separate final-C7-source Hotpot256 default compatibility; do not relabel C6 compatibility or older competitor timings as a new C7 run.

Before deciding whether to start the sole formal run, execute the separately fixed full-public MCP token1024 AB/BA development comparison once: 4060 calls and 2030 complete output pairs, original round0/round1 query orders and frozen actual-SDK timing primitives. Preserve every first call, resource-read failure and adverse value; no profiler or diagnostic hook. This check does not replace any original formal gate.

diagnostic_evidence.interpretation: Only the verified identical outputs and transparent stdout operation/dispatch counts motivate C7. The official SDK performs one write dispatch and one flush dispatch per message. Instrumented profile durations and root/caller accounting are not performance evidence. A new bound formal run must demonstrate any end-to-end benefit.

offline_saved_data_review.boundary: Offline-only reconstruction from the retained complete records; original exit1/root accounting failure is preserved, not relabeled as an unqualified successful profile.

diagnostic_evidence.postcheck_failure: All 1015 requests and output/cache/invariant checks completed before the final cProfile root-function count assertion failed. The root recall_memory node has primitive_calls=0,total_calls=391,cumulative=0 and is absent from the first-call profile; it cannot establish completion or total duration. Explicit tool events and inner recall/recall_payload nodes each record 1015. Preserve the failure and all raw records; no retry.

formal_protocol.binding: Commit the final materially changed C7 runtime, evaluator and tests, then commit its one binding before the sole exclusive formal execution.
formal_protocol.decision: Every original correctness and numerical gate must pass. Any resource trigger requires explicit independent review. Earlier sources and development gains never substitute for a missing final-source gate.
formal_protocol.evaluator: New C7 runner/workflow changes only source/provenance/path/claim registration, retaining all frozen C6 measurement primitives, native memo observations, actual SDK/client command, original matrix and numerical/resource gates. Preserve complete C3/C5/C6 rejections and C4 development evidence.

invariants: Unchanged route SQL limits/global BM25, lexical normalization, fusion arithmetic, scopes, source text/addresses, final score expressions and top-K tie order.
Unchanged source corruption checks, source snapshots, exact character/token budgets, MCP payload/envelope, result-cache behavior, schema version and dependency requirements.
Exact complete non-timing payload equivalence against published v0.3.2, including candidate_count and truncated, across retained regression configurations.

mcp_stdout_policy.encoding: same owned native UTF-8 TextIOWrapper over the standard stdout binary buffer
mcp_stdout_policy.fallback: unknown SDK version, replaced or custom SDK method, unsupported standard-stream identity or custom stdout uses the original FastMCP.run(transport=stdio) path
mcp_stdout_policy.flush_frequency: every successful message is flushed immediately; no batching across responses
mcp_stdout_policy.followup_flush: skip only the immediately following SDK flush already completed successfully by that write; standalone flush and a flush after failed write/flush delegate normally
mcp_stdout_policy.lifecycle: official stdio_server(stdout=adapter), unchanged lowlevel server initialization/lifespan/context/handlers; no explicit closing of standard process handles
mcp_stdout_policy.scope: serve standard stdio path with verified original SDK methods and a native standard stdout stream
mcp_stdout_policy.serialization: unchanged official SDK JSONRPCMessage.model_dump_json and newline
mcp_stdout_policy.thread_cancellation: preserve default non-abandoning worker behavior; propagate write and flush errors; do not change limiters or cancellation options
unchanged: C5 bounded exact-count memo and cold/warm policy
mcp_stdout_policy.write_and_flush: one default anyio.to_thread.run_sync operation calls the original native write(data), then flush(), in that order

prior_c4.decision: Complete development comparison retained, insufficient public token speed margin. C4 formal runner/workflow were prepared but never bound or executed. No same-source timing retry.

rejected_alternatives: Do not drop or defer per-message flushing, queue multiple responses, replace the official SDK/client, bypass argument validation, change response fields or select another timing boundary.
Do not disable, delay, batch or bypass result-cache writes, source integrity checks or transaction/revision safety.
Do not prioritize a JSON rewrite or increase feature caches on the instrumented root profile; its root accounting failed and it establishes no end-to-end speedup.
Do not rerun C6 or lower its failed MCP gate. Every observation and original false decision remains retained.

rejected_c3.decision: numeric gate failed; preserve all complete original observations and never rerun this source to select a faster sample

rejected_c5.decision: Preserve the complete valid C5 formal rejection. Do not rerun the same source to select a faster sample.

rejected_c6.decision: Preserve the complete valid C6 formal rejection. Do not rerun the same source to select a faster sample.

document.release: No v0.3.3 runtime approval, main advance or release branch until final acceptance and exact-source nine-job CI.

source_work_policy.cold_warm_boundary: unchanged C5 connection/configuration/query-order boundaries and all first calls; no extra warmup
source_work_policy.ownership: one recall and its original read snapshot only
source_work_policy.source_validation: unchanged full source-map and projected-unit checks
source_work_policy.sqlite_statement_cache: unchanged ordinary driver default 128; no enlargement

substantive_change: Keep the complete frozen C6 retrieval implementation, all source validations, exact outputs and existing result-cache writes. Change only the server-side standard-stdio output scheduling.

Use the official SDK supported stdout argument instead of replacing its protocol loop or wire serializer. On the precisely certified standard path, execute the same native text write and flush together in one worker dispatch for each JSON line.

After a successful combined write/flush, the paired SDK flush becomes a lightweight acknowledgement; independent flush and error paths still delegate. Retain at most small completion state, never response text across messages.

Use the original FastMCP stdio path under unknown versions, custom/replaced methods, or unsupported streams. Keep initialization, lifespan, connection ownership, schemas, stderr behavior and exception/cancellation propagation.

Validate byte-for-byte transcript/order/UTF-8 behavior, Unicode and large responses, independent/repeated flush, write/flush failure, EOF/shutdown/cancellation and unknown/custom fallbacks. Confirm the real SDK remains responsible for encoding and all ordinary cache writes occur.

binding.policy: One exclusive execution claim per binding; preserve every attempt and sample.
